final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_fee_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_per_day) AS avg_fee_per_day FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.avg_fee_per_day) AS avg_fee_per_day, AVG(r.avg_fee_per_day - o.avg_fee_per_day) AS avg_difference FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_fee_per_day > o.avg_fee_per_day
